scope: Deterministic additive VL2 TSC Section 5.4 full storage-review planning successor. It preserves the predecessor analytical no-escape raw-PVTK calculation and adds explicit mesh-bin payload projection, restart-payload planning allowances, log and telemetry allowance, filesystem-allocation overhead, the selected Orion-only replication policy and a campaign safety margin. This is a conservative planning envelope only. It contains no observed runtime payload size, does not reserve filesystem capacity, does not authorize execution and does not qualify a Section 5.4 claim.

retained_raw_pvtk_projection.particle_retention: No particle escape. All shock-injected particles with birth_time >= 45 remain retained.
retained_raw_pvtk_projection.cadence: Retain PVTK at t=0 and every declared prtcl_all PVTK dt=100 through time/tlim=1200.
retained_raw_pvtk_projection.quantization: Continuous swept-mass analytical rate. Runtime timestep-edge and carried mass-reservoir sub-particle quantization are excluded.

planning_policy.evidence_boundary: Every non-PVTK value below is a deterministic conservative planning projection or allowance, not an observed runtime payload size, measured Orion overhead, quota reservation, execution authorization or qualification result.

mesh_bin_products.ascii_headers: Not modeled byte-exactly. The filesystem-allocation overhead allowance covers headers conservatively.

restart_payload.particle_layout_source_boundary: Cosmic-ray restart particle arrays carry 26 Real fields and 4 integer fields in the bound src/athena.hpp and src/particles/particles.cpp source. The bound src/outputs/restart.cpp serializer writes those dynamic extents. The planning allowance uses 8 bytes per Real and 4 bytes per integer, for 224 bytes per retained particle. This is source-layout-derived, not a measured checkpoint size.
restart_payload.classification: Planning allowance only. Runtime AMR occupancy, rank layout, serialized checkpoint bytes, manifests and completion markers must still be measured and retained.

replication_policy.durability_risk: Orion-only retention is user-directed and does not provide an institutional or approved off-site durable archive.

remaining_runtime_obligations: Measure and retain actual PVTK, mesh-bin, restart, log and telemetry bytes for every attempted campaign run.
Retain actual runtime AMR occupancy, rank layout, filesystem usage and checkpoint publication metadata.
Confirm Orion free capacity and any required quota or reservation operationally before qualifying campaign launch.
Preserve the Orion-only durability risk until a separately reviewed durable-retention successor exists.

limitations: This successor closes the Phase 1 local storage-review planning item only.
It does not claim observed runtime payload sizes, measured Orion filesystem overhead or a filesystem reservation.
It does not authorize a Frontier submission or qualify Section 5.4 physics.
The Orion-only replication factor is one because the selected live policy has no approved bulk replica; this is recorded as a durability risk, not represented as durable archival.
